summary: Static code review + TypeScript compilation check for the validateClCode() demo guard fix in orderService.ts. TypeScript passes with 0 errors. All acceptance criteria verified via code inspection. Cannot run Playwright/browser automation on React Native Expo apps.

code_review_findings.fix_validateClCode_demo_guard: VERIFIED ✓ — orderService.ts lines 193-225: DEMO_TOKEN='demo_jwt_groveno_offline', DEMO_CL_CODE='CLDEMO123'. validateClCode() checks code.toUpperCase() === 'CLDEMO123', then AsyncStorage.getItem('groveno_token'), if it equals DEMO_TOKEN → returns {valid:true, clName:'Demo Community Leader', society:'Demo Society, Sector 21', coinsToEarn:15}. Falls through to real API call if token is not demo token (production mode protection).
code_review_findings.auth_token_alignment: VERIFIED ✓ — authService.ts line 41/52: demoToken='demo_jwt_groveno_offline' stored at key 'groveno_token'. Exactly matches DEMO_TOKEN in orderService.ts. Key symmetry confirmed.
code_review_findings.cl_validation_display: VERIFIED ✓ — HomeDeliveryCheckoutScreen.tsx lines 171-181: clInfo.clName and clInfo.coinsToEarn displayed on valid response. Will show 'Demo Community Leader' and '🪙 You will earn 15 coins after delivery'.
code_review_findings.slot_selector: VERIFIED ✓ — CL_SLOTS = DELIVERY_SLOTS.filter(s => s.id !== 'express_30min'). DELIVERY_SLOTS has 'morning' and 'evening' slots in constants/data.ts. Slot selector shows Morning and Evening for CL mode.
code_review_findings.production_protection: VERIFIED ✓ — If real JWT stored (not 'demo_jwt_groveno_offline'), CLDEMO123 falls through to api.get('/api/cl/validate/CLDEMO123') which fails offline → returns {valid:false}. Protection works.
code_review_findings.channel_propagation: VERIFIED ✓ — HomeDeliveryCheckoutScreen passes mode (which is 'cl_order' for CL flow) → PaymentScreen → placeHomeDelivery with channel='cl_order' → makeDemoOrder uses channel. Order success shows '👥 Order via CL'.
